title: Design: Manage Customers columns keep their place as the search narrows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, named for example Quokka One, so the search finds one row.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Take a screenshot of the dialog.
  6. Type quokka in the search.
  7. Replace the search with zzz.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • The screenshot shows the column headings.

Step 6:

  • Customer A's row is listed.
  • Compared with the screenshot, the Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier headings keep their place and width: nothing moves sideways or down.

Step 7:

  • A no-match message shows.
  • The headings still keep the same place and width as in the screenshot.
